notes.title: Patch 1.0.2_A
notes.notes: [p]With this update, the main storyline of the museum is finally fully explorable! We have fixed an issue that prevented all the first floor documents from being viewed and consulted.[/p][p][b]Changelog[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Sequential Document Unlocking:[/b] After viewing the first document, all other documents on the first floor are now accessible without restrictions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Story Progression:[/b] It is now possible to complete the entire main narrative arc related to the museum.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor Fixes:[/b] General optimizations and small tweaks to improve overall stability and the gameplay experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]We invite you to share your feedback and impressions: every comment is valuable to help us improve the project.[/p][p][i]The ProjectCottontails Team[/i][/p]
